ms.criteria:
・Provide documentation on the SIDAN - Delegator feedback system for DRep voting.

・The Delegator feedback system's testing should cover at least 2 governance actions, demonstrating the platform is functional as expected
・Prepare the close-out report
・Prepare the close-out video
ms.report:
A. Output: Wrap the proposal delivery, compile the full product description
Acceptance criteria: Provide documentation on the SIDAN - Delegator feedback system for DRep voting.
Evidence: 
The full product description is documented across the following files in the public GitHub repository:
・System Overview & Architecture - https://github.com/sidan-lab/drep-delegator-feedback-system/blob/main/README.md: Project goals, architecture diagram, tech stack, repository structure, local development setup, and deployment references.
・Full Product Description - https://github.com/sidan-lab/drep-delegator-feedback-system/blob/main/frontend/docs/01-project-description.md: Comprehensive feature documentation including governance dashboard, NCL tracking, wallet integration, DRep registration workflow, delegator sentiment system, data models, API integration, and user flows.
・API Documentation - https://github.com/sidan-lab/drep-delegator-feedback-system/blob/main/api/docs/swagger.json: OpenAPI 3.0 specification for all API endpoints. Also available as interactive Swagger UI at the deployed API's /api-docs route.

B. Output: Summarize the findings obtained from interacting with DReps in the process
Acceptance criteria: Provide documentation on the SIDAN - Delegator feedback system for DRep voting.
Evidence: 
・DRep & Community Feature Suggestions - https://github.com/sidan-lab/drep-delegator-feedback-system/blob/main/doc/milestone-4.md: Documents two feature enhancements directly suggested through DRep and community interaction:
・a. Voting Deadline Alerts & Reminders - Proactive notifications when proposal voting deadlines approach, with configurable alert thresholds (7 days, 3 days, 1 day before expiry) and push via Discord DM or web notification.
・b. DRep Draft Rationale Publishing - Addresses the gap where DReps only published their voting decision after voting on-chain. Adds a "Draft Vote Intent" feature enabling two-way dialogue with delegators before decisions are finalized.
・
